page.overview:
Who is Helicopter Co-Pilot?

The helicopter co-pilot was a mercenary who was affiliated with Zora Bennett. He and the rest of the crew were contracted by Zora to travel to Ile Saint-Hubert to rescue her. However, as they headed to the land, the Distortus rex grabbed the helicopter and killed all three aboard. He appeared to be rigorous and competent in his work, flying only for the two minutes that Zora had ordered.

In 2027, Zora hired him and the pilot to monitor the Essex's radio frequency in case it goes silent for 24 hours on their mission. If so, they would fly over the abandoned InGen village complex at sunset on the second night. The helipad at this location was chosen as the pickup spot because it would allow the helicopter to hover for two minutes. If no one showed up, they would leave.
